related.title: PostgreSQL：BRIN、相關性與 block 摘要
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：對少量待處理任務建立部分索引，驗證查詢條件涵蓋索引條件。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Create a partial index for sparse pending tasks and verify predicate compatibility. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用每區塊 min/max 模型判斷時間條件可跳過多少區塊。
related.differenceEn: Use block min/max summaries to identify blocks skippable by a time predicate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 部分索引只包含符合 WHERE 的列；planner 必須能證明查詢不會漏掉不在索引內的答案。 教學基準：300*32 = 9600 partial entry bytes；第二檢核：10000*32 = 320000 full entry bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
BRIN 摘要是有損候選篩選，需回表 recheck；資料與物理位置的相關性影響效益。 教學基準：10-1 = 9 skippable blocks；第二檢核：449-420+1 = 30 matching rows。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A partial index includes rows satisfying its WHERE clause; the planner must establish that omitted rows cannot be answers. Teaching baseline: 300*32 = 9600 partial entry bytes; second check: 10000*32 = 320000 full entry bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

BRIN summaries provide lossy candidate filtering requiring rechecks; physical correlation affects benefit. Teaching baseline: 10-1 = 9 skippable blocks; second check: 449-420+1 = 30 matching rows. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Raft: log conflicts and committed prefixes

related.difference: 用 index/term 表追蹤 follower 與 leader 的衝突位置，修復未提交尾端。
related.differenceEn: Trace index/term conflicts between follower and leader and repair an uncommitted suffix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

AppendEntries 以 prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm 檢查前綴；不能任意刪除已提交項目。 教學基準：4-2 = 2 conflicting follower suffix entries；第二檢核：5-2 = 3 leader suffix entries to append。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 300*32 = 9600 partial entry bytes; second check: 10000*32 = 320000 full entry bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

AppendEntries checks prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm; committed entries must not be arbitrarily removed. Teaching baseline: 4-2 = 2 conflicting follower suffix entries; second check: 5-2 = 3 leader suffix entries to append. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
